work_unit.name: prompt_group
work_unit.definition: A unique consumed prompt group, deduplicated by group_uid before source-dependent row expansion.

metric_semantics.sync.timing_s/gen: Inline rollout generation inside the synchronous serialized training loop.
metric_semantics.streamweave.timing_s/gen: Learner-side queue acquisition, deserialization, materialization, alignment, and assembly. It is not the same low-level operation as synchronous generation.
metric_semantics.timing_s/step: Non-evaluation training-loop wall-clock time logged for the cycle.
metric_semantics.hpt/onpolicy_num_groups: Unique prompt groups consumed by the learner in the cycle.
metric_semantics.system.gpu.<i>.smActive: W&B 15-second system telemetry. The integrated efficiency figure counts how many of the eight GPUs exceed the declared SM-activity threshold in each selected training interval.
metric_semantics.system.gpu.<i>.powerWatts: W&B 15-second device-power telemetry in watts. The energy estimate sums all eight GPUs and normalizes by consumed prompt groups.
metric_semantics.gpu_activity_population: System rows with all eight SM-active values that fall inside [history timestamp - timing_s/step, history timestamp] for cycles without a validation timer.
metric_semantics.gpu_energy_population: System rows with all eight power values in the same fully observed non-validation training cycles; every telemetry row is assigned to at most one cycle.

code_references.purpose: Defines sum/time_sum aggregation across fit steps and the learner-side timing ratio.
